snippet.title: FISTAGON - Gameplay Trailer - Closed Beta phase #virtualreality #vrgaming
snippet.description:
#fistagon our next top VR game! Join our discord below to test it out. 

Join our XR GAMES channel where you can meet our makers and get give aways, demo sessions, feedback and more! https://discord.gg/39pXGj2c93

Join up and become a creator or just have fun with XR creator community at https://discord.gg/pTdzDHC5ax

We have been doing XR since 2016 and we are here to enable you to become a creator and create a good place for adventurers in the new frontier of immersive apps! 

All support is welcome and we aim to give everyone a way to express themselves.
